test.name: Network install of NATS 2.15.1 to a TestRoot through the daemon

expected: With STACKLY_NATIVE_NETWORK=1, nats_installs_from_the_network downloads NATS 2.15.1 over https into an empty TestRoot and installs it to an installed runtime whose exec check printed the artifact version, with no com.apple.quarantine on any file.
actual: nats 2.15.1 (sha256 ed0fe392...5ffd, source managed) downloaded over https into an empty TestRoot and installed to an installed runtime in 4.4 s: 1 exec check (nats-server --version printed the artifact version), 2 codesign questions, no com.apple.quarantine on any installed file; the same run recorded as a native PASS with 0 evidence problems
steps: the user approved this one run through the lead (scope 02) for NATS 2.15.1, about 6.8 MB from GitHub Releases, into a TestRoot only

`STACKLY_NATIVE_NETWORK=1 cargo xtask evidence run --kind native -- cargo test -p stacklyd --test native_runtime_install --locked -- --ignored nats_installs_from_the_network` on commit 27e4135 with the cache steps passed first

the test uses the real MacosFetcher, the real adapters behind recorders, and the daemon in process; it asserts the resolved digest and size, the installed state, the exec check spawn, and `xattr -lr` finding no com.apple.quarantine
the automatic native record of the run (target/evidence) is PASS with subject nats 2.15.1 and that digest
